title: Prognostic Model of HCV-related Disease Progression After DAAs
brief_summary: In this study, the investigator would conduct an ambispective cohort study to build a prediction model of HCV-related disease after DAAs.
study_population: Adult patients (≥18 years old) with chronic HCV infection that were HCV RNA positive and have received DAA therapy were included, former hcv treatment information and sustained virologic response data were collected restropectively, liver-related events including liver-related deaths, HCC, liver decompensation, and liver transplantation were collected restropectively and prospectively.
